shigureni.termsRead: 2026-09-24 (for Poker Master; the same file, the same terms)
shigureni.summary: Free for use in apps and websites. Permitted editing includes resizing, cropping, recolouring, flipping, adding text, simple compositing and animation — a speech bubble beside the cat and the pop-up motion are both within that. Creating another illustration from theirs by any means, including hand-drawing and tracing, is forbidden, as is any generative-AI use: the cat is only ever this file, cropped and scaled, and the small cat on inline tips is a crop of it, never a redraw. Do not feed the file (or a screenshot of it) to an AI tool, including for checking how it looks.
shigureni.commercialUse: Up to 5 illustrations per production are free for commercial use; each one beyond costs ¥1,000. Chess Master uses ONE shigureni illustration (this mascot). Chess Master is a free site with no revenue, so the ceiling does not apply as things stand. Poker Master separately uses ten. Whether the series counts as one production, and what to do if either site ever earns money, is the owner's call — re-read the terms first.
